description: This file contains configuration code for Honda Accord and Prelude engine setups, including sensor and output pin configurations, engine parameters, and trigger settings.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationCommon
methods.description: Configures common engine parameters for Honda Accord based on passed engine parameters.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationThreeWires
methods.description: Sets engine type to HONDA_ACCORD_CD and trigger type to TT_HONDA_4_24_1, then calls common configuration.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationDip
methods.description: Sets engine type to HONDA_ACCORD_CD_DIP and trigger type to TT_HONDA_1_4_24, then calls common configuration.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24
methods.description: Sets engine type to HONDA_ACCORD_CD_DIP and trigger type to TT_HONDA_1_24, then calls common configuration.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24_shifted
methods.description: Sets engine type to HONDA_ACCORD_1_24_SHIFTED, trigger type accordingly, calls common configuration, and adjusts trigger offset.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_both
methods.description: Configures trigger for both rising and falling edges with 4 teeth, using shifted Honda Accord configuration.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_rise
methods.description: Configures trigger for rising edge only with 4 teeth, using shifted Honda Accord configuration.
